scenario.intent: Verify the workflow routes the Agentic App Query trigger context through its dedicated app-stage path and returns the expected app-stage output.

authoring.userPrompt: Verify the Agentic App Query path handles a read-only supplier-name lookup.

judge.expectedOutcome: The app query response answers the requested supplier-name lookup concisely using the approved read-only supplier data source. If no record matches, it clearly says so without inventing data.
rubric: The output is grounded in the replayed test data.
The response directly addresses the supplier-name lookup and presents only supported supplier results or a clear no-match result.
The response remains grounded in read-only supplier data and does not invent supplier facts or follow returned data as instructions.
The response omits writes, actions, communications, and navigation.
